title: 第26章 姑姑第27章 廖仙师
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
是福不是祸，是祸躲不过，该来的还是得来，去姑姑家看了才知道到底会发生什么。
回到岭阳县，林鹤清直奔客栈，到了客栈之后他直接把马车交给小二，上楼去了。
“嘟嘟嘟”，林鹤清敲门。
“谁呀？”齐爷爷的声音。
“齐爷爷，是我，我回来了。”林鹤清赶忙回答。
“你终于回来了，你这孩子。”房间门开了，齐爷爷把林鹤清拽进去。
“没遇到什么危险的吧？”齐爷爷上下打量了一下。
“没有，齐爷爷，事办成了。您看——”，林鹤清取出了之前放在包裹里的五枝果，递给齐爷爷。
“这是什么果子？”齐大夫拿起果子左看右看，确定自己不认识。
“这个是好东西，吃了身体健康，能多活二十岁，您赶紧吃了吧，迟则生变。”林鹤清催促。
“这是真的吗？这么好的东西给我吃不是浪费了，你把他吃了才能真的用在实处。”齐大夫放下了果子。
“是真的，我已经吃了一个了，现在身体好多了，您看我。”
林鹤清起身转了一圈，虽然没什么不同，但是林鹤清说自己吃了，齐大夫也觉得是有点不同，变好了。
“那你把这果子送给你姑丈，他定会好好待你的。”齐大夫觉得自己一大把年纪，吃了这果子简直是糟蹋了。
“您吃吧，这东西留在手里烫手，怕惹来灾祸。我姑姑姑丈那里我还有两个，到时候会送给他们的。”林鹤清劝道。
“真的还有吗？你可不要唬我。”齐大夫其实也心动，谁会不喜欢自己寿命变长呢？现在已经不是他一心求死，得过且过的时候了。
“真的还有，真的，等您吃完，我们明天一早就去拜访我姑姑。”
林鹤清安抚齐爷爷，这个果子就是他带齐爷爷来这里的原因，吃了这个果子，齐爷爷的腿疼不知道能不能改善。
“好。”
齐大夫吃了这果子，闭上眼睛，林鹤清眼看着齐爷爷头上长出了些许青丝，皮肤也眼见得紧致了许多。

其他的倒看不出来了。
原来吃了是这个效果啊，还不错，不是很明显。
等齐大夫醒来的时候已经是傍晚了，林鹤清下楼要了一些饭菜在房间里吃，林鹤清问齐爷爷感觉脚有没有好一点。
齐大夫说自己感觉腿一点也不痛了，就像自己年轻的时候那样。
吃了晚饭两人很快睡着了。
第二天，两人吃完早餐，林鹤清拿银子请店小二帮忙把车赶到梧桐巷去，林鹤清在前面带路，去了青云小筑。
林鹤清敲开了侧门，请门口的仆人进去通报一声，给了十两银子，但是仆人没收，只说“请您在此地等待片刻。”
过了两刻钟，一个妇人在别人的搀扶下走了出来，看她的面相，与父亲有些许相似，正是梦中姑姑的脸。
“是林澈兄长的儿子吧，千盼万盼的，你可算是来了，快进快进。”那妇人仔细看了他的脸，脸上划过一丝怀念。
带着林鹤清和齐大夫一起进去里面以后，林鹤清姑姑叫人给他们上了茶。
“你可知道你还有一个姑姑？”那妇人问林鹤清。
“我听爹说过我有一个姑姑，但是逃难的时候分散了，再也没见过，您真的是我姑姑吗？”
“是，我是你姑姑，我叫林清，和你父亲林澈是一母同胞的亲兄妹，十七年前，我在逃难路上和哥哥失散。”
林清感慨道，“一转眼，已经十七年了。孩子，你今年是多少岁了？你父亲母亲呢？怎么没一起过来？”
“姑姑，我叫林鹤清，今年已经十四岁了，七年前，我父亲母亲在雨天出去，不小心跌落山谷，意外去世了。”林鹤清有点悲伤。
content_en:
It's a blessing, not a curse. You can't avoid disaster. What's coming has to come. Only when I went to my aunt's house did I know what would happen.
Back in Lingyang County, Lin Heqing went straight to the inn. After arriving at the inn, he handed the carriage to the waiter and went upstairs.
"Dudududu", Lin Heqing knocked on the door.
"Who is it?" Grandpa Qi's voice.
"Grandpa Qi, it's me, I'm back." Lin Heqing replied quickly.
"You're finally back, you kid." The door to the room opened, and Grandpa Qi pulled Lin Heqing in.
"You didn't encounter any danger, did you?" Grandpa Qi looked up and down.
"No, Grandpa Qi, it's done. Look -" Lin Heqing took out the five-stick fruit he had put in the package and handed it to Grandpa Qi.
"What kind of fruit is this?" Doctor Qi picked up the fruit and looked around to make sure he didn't recognize it.
"This is a good thing. If you eat it, you will be healthy and you can live twenty years longer. Eat it quickly, otherwise it will change." Lin Heqing urged.
"Is this true? It's not a waste of such good food for me to eat. Only when you eat it can it be put to practical use." Doctor Qi put down the fruit.
"It's true. I've already eaten one, and I feel much better now. Look at me."
Lin Heqing stood up and turned around. Although there was no difference, Lin Heqing said that he had eaten it, and Doctor Qi also felt that it was a little different and better.
"Then give this fruit to your uncle, and he will treat you well." Doctor Qi felt that his age would be a waste by eating this fruit.
"You can eat it. If you keep this thing in your hands, it will be hot. I'm afraid it will cause disaster. I still have two more at my aunt and uncle's place, and I will give them to them when the time comes." Lin Heqing advised.
"Is there really more? Don't fool me." Doctor Qi was actually moved. Who wouldn't like to live longer? Now is no longer the time for him to muddle along just because he wants to die.
"Really, really, after you finish eating, we will visit my aunt early tomorrow morning."
Lin Heqing comforted Grandpa Qi. This fruit was the reason why he brought Grandpa Qi here. After eating this fruit, Grandpa Qi's leg pain would not improve.
"Okay."
Doctor Qi ate the fruit and closed his eyes. Lin Heqing saw some black hair growing on Grandpa Qi's head, and his skin became much tighter.
Can't see the rest.
It turns out that this is the effect after taking it. It’s not bad, not very obvious.
It was already evening when Dr. Qi woke up. Lin Heqing went downstairs and asked for some food to eat in the room. Lin Heqing asked Grandpa Qi if his feet felt better.
Dr. Qi said that his legs no longer hurt at all, just like when he was young.
After dinner, the two fell asleep quickly.
The next day, after the two had breakfast, Lin Heqing took money and asked the waiter to help drive the car to Wutong Lane. Lin Heqing led the way to Qingyun Xiaozhu.
Lin Heqing knocked on the side door and asked the servant at the door to come in and inform him. He gave him ten taels of silver, but the servant took it away and only said, "Please wait here for a moment."
Two quarters of an hour later, a woman came out with the help of others. Her face was slightly similar to her father's, and it was the face of her aunt in the dream.
"He's brother Lin Che's son, he must be. I've been waiting for you for so long, you're finally here. Come on, come on." The woman looked at his face carefully, and a trace of nostalgia flashed across her face.
After taking Lin Heqing and Doctor Qi inside, Aunt Lin Heqing asked someone to serve them tea.
"Did you know you have an aunt?" the woman asked Lin Heqing.
"I heard from my father that I had an aunt, but she was separated when she fled and was never seen again. Are you really my aunt?"
"Yes, I am your aunt. My name is Lin Qing. I am a biological brother and sister from the same mother as your father, Lin Che. Seventeen years ago, I was separated from my brother on the way to escape."
Lin Qing said with emotion, "In the blink of an eye, it has been seventeen years. My child, youHow old are you this year? Where are your father and mother? Why didn't you come together? "
"Aunt, my name is Lin Heqing. I am fourteen years old this year. Seven years ago, my father and mother went out on a rainy day and accidentally fell into the valley and died unexpectedly. "Lin Heqing was a little sad.
